Subject: Hosted API evaluation — can we schedule a quick demo?

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for the hosted API trial earlier this week (testing embeddings + chat for a prototype). I pushed some test traffic and have a few questions about production best practices (rate limits, batching, and model selection for short responses).

Would you be available for a 30-min walkthrough next week? Prefer mornings PST.

Thanks,
Alex Goldman
Senior ML Engineer
FinLytics
alex@finlytics.com

P.S. happy to send a short summary of what we tested if that helps prepare the demo.

I can do a 30-min walkthrough and cover rate limits, batching recommendations, and quick notes on model choices for low-latency text and embeddings. A few times that work for me next week:
- Tue 02/17, 9:30–10:00 AM PT
- Wed 02/18, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Thu 02/19, 8:30–9:00 AM PT

You can also pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Agenda (tentative):
- Quick context on your prototype (5 min)

Attaching a short agenda PDF.

Best,
